result.stdout:
monorepo-dotnet — interactive ASP.NET Core solution generator

Usage: monorepo [--help]

The CLI is interactive: it asks for the solution name, output directory,
application (Web API, MVC or Console), architecture, database, Docker and 
optional packages.
Generated solutions target net10.0.

Requirements: .NET 10 SDK, Docker (optional), dotnet-ef (optional).
Missing SDK: the CLI prints Microsoft install commands and can run them for you.
